jvarādau uṣṇodakavidhiṃ darśayannāha -- aṣṭamenāṃśaśeṣeṇa caturthenārdhakena vā | athavā kathanenaiva siddhamuṣṇodakaṃ vadet || 159 || śleṣmāmavātamedoghnaṃ bastiśodhanadīpanam | kāsaśvāsajvaraharaṃ pītamuṣṇodakaṃ niśi || 160 ||
Dī. aṣṭameneti | yat kevalameva pānīyamaṣṭamāṃśādikalpanayā siddhaṃ bhavati taduṣṇodakamiti saṃjñaṃ vadediti | aṃśaśeṣeṇāṣṭādibhiḥ pratyekamabhisaṃbadhyate; tena aṣṭāṃśena caturthāṃśenārdhāṃśenetyarthaḥ | aṃśastvatra kvathanāvaśiṣṭaḥ | athavetyanena pakṣāntaramāha | kvathanenaivetyādi | kvathanamityatra tripādaśeṣamityarthaḥ | etat kriyācatuṣṭayaṃ doṣāpekṣayābhihitam | tathāhi - “tatpādahīnaṃ pittaghnaṃ taccheṣamanilāpaham | ardhaṃ kṣayakaphaharaṃ śeṣaṃ grāhi tridoṣajit” iti | nanu yathaivaṃ tarhi suśrutena “tatpādahīnavātaghnamardhahīnaṃ tu pittajit | kaphaghnaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ ca pānīyaṃ dīpanaṃ smṛtam” iti kathametadviparītamuktam ? | satyam | ādyaḥ pakṣo vyavahārī sa ca jvaradīnāṃ doṣaprakope praśastaḥ, dvitīyastu ṣaḍṛtuṣu doṣāpekṣayā'bhihitaḥ | suśrute uktaṃ ca “śāradaṃcārdhapādonaṃ pādahīnaṃ tu haimakam | śiśire ca vasante ca grīṣme pādāvaśeṣitam | viparītamṛtuṃ dṛṣṭvā vārṣikaṃ cāṣṭabhāgikam” iti | yadvirodhaparihāraḥ kṛtastat sādhubhirvicāraṇīyaḥ atra vistarabhayānna likhitaḥ | siddhamiti yadgrahaṇaṃ laghūktikvathananimittam | yataḥ “yat kvāthyamānaṃ nirvegaṃ niṣphenaṃ nirmalaṃ tathā | śṛtaśītaṃ tridoṣaghnaṃ vāṣpāntarbhāvaśītalam” iti | anyathā doṣakaraḥ syāt | tathāhi - “dhārāpātena viṣṭambhi durjaraṃ pavanāhṛtam | śṛtaśītaṃ punastaptaṃ tatsarvaṃ doṣalaṃ smṛtam” iti | athoṣṇodakasya niśi pītasya guṇamāha - kāseti | etaduṣṇodakaṃ yadā niśi pītaṃ tadā śleṣmādikān hantīti | uṣṇodakaṃ vadediti | īṣaduṣṇam uṣṇodakaṃ kathitaṃ | vātamedoghnamiti vātaghnaṃ medoghnaṃ ca | śleṣmāmavātamedoghnamiti vā pāṭhāntaram | bastiśodhanaṃ mūtrāśayaśuddhikaraṃ, dīpanamagneḥ | pītamuṣṇodakamiti | īṣaduṣṇaṃ pītam | niśīti niśāmukhe śayanakāle vā na tu sakalaniśāyāṃ muhurmuhuḥ pānaṃ tatra niṣedhaparatvāt | tathāhi - “yathā divā tathā rātrau yadi toyaṃ pibennaraḥ | bhavet tatra rasādhikyaṃ taccheṣāddoṣakopanam” iti satyam | eṣa svasthe prasaṅga iti vartate vyavahārādāture na kutracit pratiṣedhaḥ | tathāhyuktam - “pānīyaṃ prāṇināṃ prāṇā viśvameva ca tanmayam | ato'tyantaniṣedhena na kvacidvāri vāryate” iti || 159 || 160 ||
Gū. atha jvarādau uṣṇodakavidhi: | aṣṭamenāṃśena caturthena caturthāṃśaśeṣe ardhakenārdhāṃśaśeṣeṇa athavā kvathanena kvathitamātreṇa siddham uṣṇodakaṃ vadet uṣṇodakaṃ niśi pītaṃ śleṣmāmavātādīnhantīti yojanā | atrānukramamapi granthāntarāt jvarādau uṣṇajalavidhānamāha - kaphavātajvarā iti | kaphajvare vātajvare kaphavātajvare vā vyaste samaste vā uṣṇam ardhāvaśiṣṭaṃ deyaṃ, “ardhāvaśiṣṭatoyaṃ yat taduṣṇodakamucyate” ityuktatvāt pittamadyaviṣotthajvareṣu tiktakaiḥ smṛtaṃ śītalaṃ deyaṃ, tiktakaśṛtastu ṣaḍaṅgakastaruṇajvare tasyaiva vidhānāt, tathācoktaṃ ‘tiktaparpaṭakośīracandanodīcyanāgaraiḥ | śṛtaśītaṃ jalaṃ dadyātpipāsājvaraśāntaye’ | ayaṃ ṣaḍaṅgastiktakaḥ smṛtaḥ, asyaiva taruṇajvare vidhānamuktaṃ suśrute - “laṅghanaṃ kārayetkāle yāvanastiktako rasaḥ | pācanānyapyapakvānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ taruṇajvare” suśrutādetat | svedanaṃ taruṇajvare niṣiddhamapi sannipātajvare vihitatvāduktaṃ kālo'pi pāvanatvena gṛhītastathā vātakaḥ saptarātreṇetyādi | anya evamāhuḥ “pādaśeṣaṃ ca vātaghnam ardhaśeṣaṃ ca pittajit | kaphaghnaṃ pādāśeṣaṃ syātpānīyaṃ dīpanaṃ laghu” | iti madanavinodāt || 159 || 160|| ityuṣṇodakavidhi: ||
idānīṃ kṣīrapākavidhimāha - kṣīramaṣṭaguṇaṃ dravyātkṣīrānnīraṃ caturguṇam | kṣīrāvaśeṣaṃ tatpītaṃ śūlamāmodbhavaṃ jayet || 161 || pañcamūlapayaḥ | (sarvajvarāṇāṃ jīrṇānāṃ kṣīraṃ bhaiṣajyamuttamam | śvāsātkāsācchiraḥśūlātpārśvaśūlātsapīnasāt ||162|| mucyate jvaritaḥ pītvā pañcamūlīśṛtaṃ payaḥ | trikaṇṭakapayaḥ | trikaṇṭakabalāvyāghrīguḍanāgarasādhitam || 163 || varcomūtravibandhaghnaṃ kaphajvaraharaṃ payaḥ139 |)
Dī. kṣīramiti | kṣīramatra gavyam | atrānuktatvāt | dravyamiti śuṇṭhīvitunnakādikamanyato darśanāt | tathāhi -“śuṇṭhīvitunnakairaṇḍaśṛtaṃ śūlaharaṃ payaḥ” iti | kartavyatāsya dravyāṇāṃ bhāgaikaṃ yathā doṣāpekṣayā parimitaṃ kṣīrasya bhāgāṣṭakaṃ, pānīyaṃ dvātriṃśadbhāgayutam | etat sakalaṃ kvāthyakṣīrāvaśeṣaṃ vastreṇa saṃsrāvya pibet | pānamānaṃ cāsya kvāthavadboddhavyam | doṣānusārato vā | āmodbhavaṃ śūlamiti | āmaśūlaṃ nanu āmavātajanitapīḍāṃ tatra kṣīrasya niṣiddhatvāt | taduktam - “dadhimatsyaguḍakṣīrapotakīmāṣapiṣṭakam | varjayedāmavātārto māṃsamānūpajaṃ tathā” iti | āmaḥ aparipakvo'nnarasaḥ | tathāhi - “jaṭharānaladaurbalyādavipakvastu yo rasaḥ | sa āmasaṃjñako dehe sarvadoṣaprakopajaḥ” iti | kecidatrāmaśūlaṃ pariṇāmajaṃ śūlamāmananti etadapi saṅgatam | dravyāditi sāmānyagrahaṇenānyeṣāmapi kṣīrayogānāṃ vidhānameva boddhavyam | yathā - “bastiśuddhikarāvāpaṃ caturguṇajalaṃ payaḥ | āvārināśāt kvathitaṃ śukrodāvartanāśanam” iti | etadapi prasaṅgato vyācaṣṭe | atra bastiśuddhikarāṇi tṛṇapañcamūlīvīratarvādīni āvāpa iha kṣīraśodhanārthaṃ kalkaḥ | tathāhyuktam - “kuśaḥ kāśaḥ śaro darbha ikṣuśceti tṛṇodbhavam | pittakṛcchraharaṃ pañcamūlaṃ bastiviśodhanam || etat siddhaṃ payaḥ pītaṃ meḍhragaṃ hanti śoṇitam” iti ||161-163||
Gū. atha kṣīrapākavidhiḥ | dravyamauṣadhaṃ tathāca vṛndaḥ - “pañcamūlīśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ pippalī vāpi tacchṛtaṃ | śiṃśipā gaṇḍikā nimbā dhāroṣṇaṃ vājvarāpaham” | śiṃśipāyā: gaṇḍikā na bhinnaṃ dravyaṃ śiṃśipāyāḥ suśrute sāro gṛhītaḥ, tathāca ‘udakāddviguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ śiṃśipāsārasaṃyutaṃ | kvāthitaṃ kṣīraśeṣaṃ ca sarvajvaragadāpaham’ ||161-1 63|| iti kṣīrapākavidhiḥ ||
saṃprati yavāgūprabhṛtikānnaprakriyāmāha - athānnaprakriyātraiva procyate nātivistarāt || 164 || yavāgūḥ ṣaṅguṇajale siddhā syātkṛśarā ghanā | taṇḍulairmudgamāṣaiśca tilairvā sādhitā hitā || 165 || yavāgūrgrāhiṇī bālyā tarpaṇī vātanāśinī |
Dī. athānneti | athetyanantaram | annaprakriyeti yavāgūvilepīpeyādirūpā | atrāsmingranthe nātivistarāt saṃkṣepamātrāt, yato vistarakathanaṃ sarveṣāmapyālasyakaraṃ bhavati | teṣu pūrvaṃ yavāgūvidhimāha - yavāgūrityādi | ṣaḍguṇe jale pānīye yā siddhā sā yavāgūśabdavācyā, ṣaḍguṇamityannaparimāṇāt | eṣā taṇḍulaireva sādhyā vyavahārāt tathā sādhyā yathā viraladravā bhavati | yataḥ - ‘yavāgūrvidravā’ iti vacanāt | asyā bhedaḥ kṛśareti nāmnā kathitā, sā ghanā dravarahitā ityarthaḥ | iyamapi taṇḍulādibhiḥ sādhitā bhavati atra mudgamāṣaiśceti cakārāt vyastaṃ grāhyaṃ tena mudgasādhitā māṣasādhitā vā | tilānyatrobhayatra yojyāni | tantrāntare'pi tilataṇḍulamāṣakṛtā yavāgūreva kṛśarā kathyate | kecidanuktatvāt tilamāṣataṇḍulānāmatra sāmyaṃ manyante, tanna manoharam, kintu vyavahārāttaṇḍulānāṃ bhāgadvayaṃ, māṣasya bhāgaikam, ardhabhāgikaṃ tilānāmiti | sakalebhyaḥ ṣaḍguṇajalamityarthaḥ | yavāgūriti sāmānyenāsyā bahavo bhedāḥ santi | tadyathā dugdhataṇḍulayavāgū:, ghṛtataṇḍulayavāgūḥ, māṃsataṇḍulayavāgūḥ, phalakandataṇḍulayavāgūrityetāḥ sarvā yavāgvo dravyā'nusārato guṇakarāḥ sādhanīyāśca bhavanti | idānīṃ tasyā guṇamāha - yavāgūrityādi | grāhiṇī saṃgrāhikā atīsārādīnāṃ, balyā balakāriṇī ojovṛddhikarītyarthaḥ | tarpaṇī dhātūnāṃ tṛptijananī | vātapraṇāśinī ceti svabhāvāt ||164||1 65||
Gū. athānnaprakriyā | ṣaḍguṇe jale siddhā yavāgū: syāt | tataḥ ghanā kṛśarā syāt, sā taṇḍulairmudgamāṣaiśca tilairvā sādhitā vātādīnāṃ, kṛśarānnaprakārabhedabhinnā ||164||65||ityannaprakriyāyāṃ yavāgū ||
atha vilepīvivaraṇaṃ darśayannāha - vilepī ghanasikthā syātsiddhā nīre caturguṇe ||166|| tarpaṇī bṛṃhaṇī hṛdyā madhurā pittanāśinī |
Dī. vilepīti | yā caturguṇe nīre pānīye siddhā niṣpannā sā vilepīśabdavācyā | svarūpeṇa ghanasikthā bhavati caturguṇanīratvāt | caturguṇamityatra annaparimāṇāt | iyamapyatra kevalaṃ taṇḍulaiḥ siddheti rūḍhi: | asau gulahathīti loke kathitā | guṇānapyasyā darśayannāha - tarpaṇītyādi | tarpaṇī tṛptijanikā, hṛdyetyāhlādakāriṇī, madhurā miṣṭarasā, ata eva pittavināśini vihitā || 166 ||
Gū. atha vilepītyādi spaṣṭam || 166 |
idānīṃ peyāyūṣāvapyāha - dravādhikā svalpasikthā caturdaśaguṇe jale ||167|| siddhā peyā budhairjñeyā yūṣaḥ kiṃcidghanastataḥ | peyā laghutarā jñeyā grāhiṇī dhātupuṣṭidā || 168 || yūṣo balyastataḥ kaṇṭhyo laghupākaḥ kaphāpahaḥ |
Dī. dravādhikā iti | yā caturdaśaguṇe jale siddhā bhavati sā peyā jñeyā | svarūpeṇa ca sā dravādhikā svalpasikthā| kecit sa bhaktamaṇḍa iti vadanti | maṇḍastu siktharahita iti prasiddhaḥ | tathāhi - “yavāgū: ṣaḍguṇe toye saṃsiddhā viraladravā | caturguṇāmbusaṃsiddhā vilepī ghanasikthakā || peyā sikthānvitā toye caturdaśaguṇe kṛtā | maṇḍaścaturdaśaguṇe siddhastoye sasikthakaḥ” iti | yūṣamapyāha - tata iti | tasmāt peyā rūpadravyāt yaḥ kiñcidghanasāndro bhavati sa yūṣa ityucyate | eṣa yūṣaḥ kevalamudgaiḥ kṛtaḥ iti sāmānyenāsya kecit | yato mudgarasa iti loke atrāpi caturdaśaguṇaṃ jalaṃ deyam | annaparimāṇāt yūṣa iti sāmānyenāsya bahavo bhedāḥ santi te cāṣṭādaśaguṇe jale sādhyā iti tantrāntarīyamatam | tathāhi “syāddhitaḥ sādhito yūṣastvaṣṭādaśaguṇe jale” iti | guṇamanayorvaktumāha - peyā laghutaretyādi | laghutarā atyarthaṃ laghupākā, grāhiṇī grāhikā atisārādīnāṃ | nanu dravamannamatīsāre niṣiddhaṃ | yaduktam | “varjayedvidalaṃ śūlī kuṣṭhī māṃsaṃ kṣayī striyam | dravamannamatīsārī sarvaṃ ca taruṇajvarī” tatkathaṃ peyā'tīsāre vihitā ? ucyate, avihitadravā'nnaniṣedhārthaṃ vākyamidam, peyāyavāgvādivihitameva | tathācoktaṃ suśrute “kāryaṃ cānaśanasyānte pradravaṃ laghubhojanam” iti | atra pradravaṃ prakṛṣṭadravaṃ, laghu yavāgvādi | tathaiva niṣiddhācaraṇaṃ bhojenā'pyuktam “vraṇodarasthāpanapātitānāṃ pramehiṇāṃ chardyātisāriṇāṃ ca | dravaṃ na dayādathavāpi koṣṇaṃ svalpaṃ hitaṃ bheṣajasaṃprayuktam” iti | yūṣo'pi balyo balakaraḥ, kaṇṭhyaḥ kaṇṭhe hitaḥ, pāke laghuḥ kaphāpahaśca ata evātra mudgayūṣaḥ kṛtākṛtaśca kathitaḥ | tathāhi “kaphaghno dīpano hṛdyaḥ śuddhānāṃ vraṇināmapi | uktaḥ pathyatamaścāpi mudgayūṣaḥ kṛtākṛtaḥ” iti || 167 || 168 ||
Gū. peyāyūṣau kṛtānnabhedau || 167 || 168 || iti peyāyūṣau ||
idānīṃ bhaktavidhimāha - jale caturdaśaguṇe taṇḍulānāṃ catuṣpalam ||169 || vipacetsrāvayenmaṇḍaṃ sa bhakto madhuro laghuḥ |
Dī. jala iti | taṇḍulānāṃ catuṣpalaṃ kuḍavamitaṃ grāhyam | caturdaśaguṇe pānīye vipācya taddravaṃ pānīyo'vaśiṣṭaḥ sa bhakta iti prasiddhaḥ | guṇo'pi rase madhuraḥ, pāke laghuriti | etadbahujalaparimāṇaṃ parisrutārtham | na tu tantrāntare bhaktaṃ pañcaguṇe sādhyamiti | tathāhi - “śṛtaṃ pañcaguṇe bhaktaṃ vilepīti caturguṇe” iti | tatkathaṃ caturdaśaguṇamatra jalam ? ucyate - bhaktaṃ dvividhaṃ sudhautaprasrutam adhautāsrutaṃ ca, yat sudhautaprasrutaṃ tacca caturdaśaguṇe jale sādhyam, adhautāsrataṃ ca pañcaguṇe iti bhāvaḥ | tathācoktam - “sudhautaprasrutaṃ coṣṇaṃ viśadaṃ guṇavanmatam | adhautaprasrutaṃ śītaṃ guruvṛṣyaṃ kaphapradam” iti ||169||
Gū. jala iti sarvaṃ sugamam || 169 ||
adhunā śuddhamaṇḍamāha - nīre caturdaśaguṇe siddho maṇḍastvasikthakaḥ ||170|| śuṇṭhīsaindhavasaṃyuktaḥ pācano dīpanaḥ smṛtaḥ |
Dī. nīre iti | caturdaśaguṇe nīre taṇḍulaparimāṇāt siddho niṣpannaḥ | asikthaka iti siktho bhaktāvayavaḥ tena rahita ityarthaḥ | ya īdṛśaḥ maṇḍasaṃjñayā prasiddhaḥ | eṣa yadā śuṇḍīsaindhavacūrṇena prakṣiptastadā pācana āmādīnām, dīpano jaṭharāgneśca smṛtaḥ kathita ityarthaḥ.| ayamabhṛṣṭataṇḍulairjanitaḥ | ata eva śuddhamaṇḍo'bhihitaḥ | yato maṇḍastantrāntare trividho darśitaḥ | tadyathā “maṇḍastu trividho jñeya ekadvitriparisrutaḥ | lājairbhṛṣṭairabhṛṣṭaiśca taṇḍulaiḥ parisaṃskṛtaḥ | catustriṃśadguṇaṃ bhaktāt pūrvaḥ pūrvo laghurhitaḥ” iti ||170|| iti śuddhamaṇḍaḥ ||
athāṣṭaguṇamaṇḍamāha -- dhānyatrikaṭusindhūtthamudgataṇḍulayojitaḥ140 || 171 || bhṛṣṭaśca hiṅgutailābhyāṃ sa maṇḍo'ṣṭaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | dīpanaḥ prāṇado bastiśodhano raktavardhanaḥ ||172 || jvarajitsarvadoṣaghno maṇḍo'ṣṭaguṇa ucyate |
Dī. dhānyeti | dhānyādibhirdravyaiḥ saṃskṛto hiṅgutailābhyāṃ saha bhṛṣṭo bharjitaḥ sa maṇḍo'ṣṭaguṇasaṃjñaḥ kathitaḥ | atra taṇḍulamudgayordānamannaprakaraṇādavagantavyam | tathāca tantrāntare “sutaṇḍulānāṃ prasṛtidvayaṃ ca tadardhamudgāḥ kaṭukatrayaṃ ca | kustumbarīsaindhavahiṅgutakrairebhiḥ samastaiḥ kriyate ca maṇḍaḥ” ityādi | atra yat śārṅgadhareṇa tailagrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tat bharjanārthaṃ taṇḍulamudgayoḥ | anyatrāpyuktam “taṇḍulairardhamudgāṃśaiḥ kiṃcidbhṛṣṭaiḥ supācitaḥ | hiṅgusindhū- tthadhanikātakratrikaṭusaṃskṛtaḥ || jñeyaḥ so'ṣṭaguṇo maṇḍo jvaradoṣatrayāpahaḥ” ityādi | kecit kartavyavidhau cāsya kaṭukatrayacūrṇaṃ paścāt prakṣepe manāg deyamiti vadanti | sa maṇḍa iti sthāne sa bhakta ityapare paṭhanti; tanmate tu īṣatsikthayuta ityarthaḥ, gato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ | aṣṭaguṇa iti yat pūrvaṃ tānāha - dīpana ityādi | agnerdīpanaḥ, prāṇado balakaraḥ, bastiśodhano bastiśuddhikaraḥ, bastirmūtrādhāraḥ, ata eva mūtralo vikhyātaḥ | raktavardhana iti śoṇitavṛddhi- karaḥ | jvarajit sarvajvaraharaḥ prabhāvāt | sarvadoṣaghna iti vātapittakaphānāṃ pratyekaṃ hantā na tu sannipātajvaraharaḥ aṣṭasaṃjñatvāt | tathāca tantrāntare “kṣuddīpano bastiviśodhanaśca prāṇaprado raktavivardhanaśca | jvarāpahārī kaphapitta- hantā vāyuṃ jayedaṣṭaguṇo hi maṇḍaḥ” || 171 || 172 ||
Gū. atha maṇḍaḥ | asikthakaḥ siktharahitaḥ dhānyādibhiryojitaḥ hiṅgutailābhyāṃ bhṛṣṭaśca sa maṇḍo'ṣṭaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ kathitaḥ | aṣṭau dīpanādayo guṇā yasya sudīpanādvayo jvarāntāḥ pañca | sarvadoṣaghna iti vātapittakaphaghneti tritayaṃ evamaṣṭaguṇaḥ | taṇḍulaṃ mudraṃ palamātraṃ, dhānyaṃ trikaṭusindhūtthaṃ yathāparimitam | anye'ṣṭaguṇamaṇḍamevāhuḥ, sugamamanyat || 171 || 172 || ityaṣṭaguṇamaṇḍa: ||
idānīṃ vāṭyamaṇḍamāha - sukaṇḍitaistathā bhṛṣṭairvāṭyamaṇḍo yavairbhayet ||173|| kaphapittaharaḥ kaṇṭhyo raktapittaprasādanaḥ |
Dī. sukaṇḍitairiti | ayaṃ vāṭyamaṇḍo dalitayavagodhūmādikṛto vyakta eva tathā'pi kiñcidvyācaṣṭe sukaṇḍitairiti | musalādibhirulūkhale saṅkuṭṭitaiḥ tuṣavarjitairityaryaḥ | tathā bhṛṣṭairiti bharjitaiḥ | tatheti grahaṇena yathā na dagdhairityarthaḥ | īdṛśaiḥ yavaiḥ, yavo'nnaviśeṣaḥ, bahuvacanatvena godhūmādayo grāhyāḥ | sa ca kaphapittaharaḥ, kaphaharaḥ pittaharaśca | saṃyogaharo vā | kaṇṭhya iti kaṇṭharogebhyo hitaḥ | raktapittaprasādan iti prakarṣeṇa sādayati iti sādanaḥ kupitāsrapittaśāntikara ityarthaḥ, na tu raktapittapravṛddhikaraḥ | tathāhi “vāṭyamaṇḍo laghurgrāhī śūlānāhāsrapittajit” iti| keciditi vyākhyānayanti | prakupitaṃ raktapittaṃ nirmalaṃ karoti svaprakṛtisthitaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | apare raktapittaniṣūdana iti paṭhanti | tadyaktam || 173 ||
Gū. atha vāṭyamaṇḍaḥ | sukaṇḍitaiḥ kṛtanistuṣai: bhraṣṭairyavairvāṭyamaṇḍaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | kaṇṭharogeṣu hitaḥ rakta- pittaprasādanaḥ śamakaḥ ||173 || iti vāṭyamaṇḍaḥ ||
atha lājamaṇḍamāha - lājairvā taṇḍulairbhṛṣṭairlājamaṇḍa: prakīrtitaḥ || 174|| śleṣmapittaharo grāhī pipāsājvarajinmataḥ | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne kvāthakalpanā- dhyāyo dvitīyaḥ |
Dī. lājairiti | bhṛṣṭaśālibhavā lājā ityucyante| taiḥ kṛtvā yaḥ sādhitaḥ sa lājamaṇḍaḥ kathitaḥ | sādhanamatra pūrvavat jñātavyam | athavā bhṛṣṭaistaṇḍulaiśca kṛto yaḥ so'pi lājamaṇḍasaṃjñitaḥ | asya guṇamāha - śleṣmapittaharaḥ ityādi| śleṣmaharaḥpittaharaśca | grāhī saṃprāhakaḥ | pipāsājvarajinmata iti | pipāsā pātumicchā iti sāmānyagrahaṇenāṣṭadhā | atra lājādīnāṃ parimāṇaṃ pūrvamaṇḍavajjñātavyam | nanu yadyevaṃ tarhi kimasau pṛthak darśitaḥ ? ucyate, lājamaṇḍasaṃjñādijñāpanārthaṃ pṛthaguktam| iti na doṣaḥ ||174|| iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe kvāthakalpanādhyāyo dvitīyaḥ || 2 ||
Gū. atha lājamaṇḍa: | lājā purātanabharjitaśālidhānyajāḥ taiḥ kṛtaḥ tadvattairvā bhṛṣṭaiḥ kṛtaḥ sa lājamaṇḍaḥ prakīrtitaḥ sa śleṣmādiharaḥ grāhī grahaṇyatisārasaṃbhaktaḥ || 174 || iti lājamaṇḍaḥ | iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne kvāthādikalpanādhyāyaḥ ||2||
